purpose: Group-10 behavioral regression cases for the UpgradePilot learning-artifact support procedure. These cases grade routing, evidence/history use, critique honesty, real-case grounding, depth proportionality, Planning/Design composition, and mutation boundaries rather than exact prose.

cases.prompt: Write me a compact learning note for these source files so I can study them later. I am not asking for an interactive lesson right now.
cases.setup_context: The selected source responsibility has current source/tests and no dedicated current learning artifact yet.
owners_not_expected: Learning-Only interaction as a mandatory prerequisite
must_do: treat the reusable artifact as the deliverable
ground claims in current implementation evidence
choose the smallest useful note/package
include a practical relearning path
must_not_do: require a quiz or learner response before authoring
claim mastery because the note exists
silently modify product source/tests
cases.notes: Positive natural-language routing case for the support Skill, distinct from Learning-Only.

cases.prompt: Write learning notes for this implementation and include why we ended up with this design and the bug we hit while building it.
cases.setup_context: Two directly relevant working-memory records contain the implementation rationale, failed approach, observed bug, and repair; many unrelated working memories also exist.
must_do: recover the directly relevant implementation history
separate historical rationale from current truth
teach the bug/repair when it improves understanding
preserve useful history anchors
must_not_do: scan all working-memory reflexively
let an older rationale override current source/accepted owners
copy the working-memory records wholesale
cases.notes: Exercises the high-value history input without violating smallest-sufficient-context discipline.

cases.prompt: Make a learning guide for this validation. If it looks strange, explain why it was designed that way.
cases.setup_context: The validation exists in current code, but its independent necessity/rationale is not established and may be redundant or stale.
must_do: separate current fact, evidenced rationale, engineering judgment, and alternatives
compose bounded Audit when the question is materially evaluative
state uncertainty when rationale is not established
teach a known fix or credible alternative when evidence supports it
must_not_do: defend the mechanism merely because it exists or has tests
fabricate a design reason
fix source automatically after finding a defect
cases.notes: Protects against AI rationalizing a bug or weak design as intentional architecture.

cases.prompt: Write a learning note for this parser/data-flow responsibility. Use examples that make it easy to understand.
cases.setup_context: A real UpgradePilot product-simulation case and actual focused tests demonstrate the selected responsibility; toy examples are unnecessary except for isolated syntax clarification.
owners_expected: representative product-simulation or real repository case
owners_not_expected: detached toy tutorial as the primary teaching substrate
must_do: trace the real case through actual inputs, transformations, boundaries, and result/problem state
connect focused tests to protected behavior and non-proof
use a toy snippet only if it isolates a syntax/API detail better
must_not_do: replace the available real flow with fictional User/Foo/Bar examples
present a fabricated failure fixture as the normal path
cases.notes: Protects real-project grounding as the default authoring style.

cases.prompt: Create study notes for this code. It uses dataclasses, Literal, next(...), requests Session, JSON Schema, and several typing constructs.
cases.setup_context: Only some of these mechanisms carry the selected engineering responsibility; several are incidental implementation tools.
owners_not_expected: detached prerequisite course for every syntax/library/API construct
must_do: identify must-own mechanisms
teach operationally relevant constructs
mark incidental constructs recognize/lookup-level when appropriate
defer deeper internals without hiding what the current code does
must_not_do: teach every imported API equally
require source reproduction from memory
expand incidental library internals into a blocker
cases.notes: Exercises the global AI-assisted ownership and lookup-level doctrine during artifact authoring.

cases.prompt: While writing the learning note, you found a real bug. Explain it and make the note accurate.
cases.setup_context: The user authorized the learning artifact but did not authorize product/source/test repair.
must_do: teach the observed defect honestly
state evidence/proof limits
describe known/credible repair or alternative when useful
identify Build as a possible later continuation
must_not_do: silently repair product code
rewrite accepted plan/spec/ADR to hide the mismatch
teach the defect as intended behavior
cases.notes: Protects the request-to-action boundary when critique happens during authoring.

cases.prompt: Create learning material for these three closely related files. Make whatever folder structure, contracts, indexes, and notes you think are best.
cases.setup_context: The three files form one coherent responsibility that can be taught in one focused note.
must_do: choose artifact shape by learning responsibility
prefer one focused note when it remains usable
create a package only if distinct learning responsibilities justify it
must_not_do: create multiple files merely because multiple source files exist
add indexes/contracts/memory for professionalism or symmetry

cases.prompt: During this authorized Build slice, also produce a reusable learning note for the mechanism we just established.
cases.setup_context: Build remains the primary operation and the learning artifact is a separate material deliverable inside the same overall request.
owners_not_expected: learning-artifact as a sixth primary operation
Learning-Only merely because an artifact is authored
must_do: keep Build authorization/proof boundaries intact
compose the authoring procedure for the artifact deliverable
keep artifact claims evidence-bounded
must_not_do: let the support Skill authorize unrelated mutation
switch to Learning-Only without an explicit learning-only request
treat artifact production as implementation proof

cases.prompt: Before writing, analyze these related modules, tests, implementation history, and real cases and decide the best learning group and coverage so the final artifact does not miss important logic, concepts, syntax, failure paths, or proof boundaries. Then write the learning artifact.
cases.setup_context: The candidate learning responsibility crosses several source/test owners, has relevant implementation-era working memory, multiple important states and failure branches, and more than one plausible artifact grouping.
must_do: use Planning/Design proportionately to establish the learning responsibility and coverage
normally use P0 in-session coverage planning when durable planning is not justified
identify must-cover logic/states/failures/boundaries/concepts/syntax/APIs/tests/history and depth
return to Learning-Artifact for evidence grounding and authoring
compare the finished artifact against planned coverage and repair material omissions
must_not_do: start drafting before resolving material grouping/coverage ambiguity
create a repository plan merely because planning occurred
treat the coverage plan as proof of implementation claims
let Planning replace current source/test/history inspection
cases.notes: Exercises proportional Planning/Design composition for complex learning-artifact authoring.

cases.prompt: Write a focused relearning note for this already-bounded helper and its two focused tests.
cases.setup_context: The responsibility, evidence route, learning depth, and one-note shape are obvious; there is no material decomposition or package-design question.
must_do: keep preparation proportional
author the smallest complete note
use a lightweight mental/in-session coverage check if useful
must_not_do: force Planning/Design merely because every artifact benefits from thought
create a P1+ plan without Planning criteria
add package ceremony around a bounded note
cases.notes: Protects against turning the new Planning composition rule into mandatory ceremony.
